tool_schemas.name: get_transcript
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the latest stored successful transcript for the YouTube video identified by the provided URL and preferred language (default: "en"), returning the transcript payload segmented into timed cues for that video/language when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the URL is missing/invalid or the language code is not a supported format, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to request transcripts. Raises NOT_FOUND when no successful transcript exists for the resolved video id in the requested language, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when request rate or quota limits are exceeded.

url.description: The URL of the YouTube video
url.title: Url

lang.description: The preferred language for the transcript
lang.title: Lang

tool_schemas.name: list_transcript_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists transcript request attempts, optionally filtered by status, video, or language. Returns a paginated set of transcript_requests ordered by most recent first. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access.

served_from_cache.description: Filter by whether the request was served from cache.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_transcript_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single transcript_requests record by id, including its terminal status and any associated transcript_id. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access.

tool_schemas.name: create_transcript_request
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new transcript request attempt for the given YouTube URL and preferred language (default: "en"). Returns the created transcript_requests row in status "queued"; processing may occur asynchronously. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted.

url.description: The URL of the YouTube video to fetch a transcript for.

lang.description: Preferred language code for the transcript request (defaults to "en").

tool_schemas.name: list_transcripts
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored transcripts, optionally filtered by video and language and/or status. Returns a paginated set of transcripts ordered by most recently fetched first. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: update_transcript
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a transcript and/or drives allowed lifecycle transitions (active→superseded/deleted, superseded→deleted). Returns the updated transcript. Refuses INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION if the requested status change is not allowed, and NOT_FOUND/UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN as appropriate.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the transcript (must be a valid transition).

source.description: Optional source label for how the transcript was obtained (e.g., "youtube").

metadata.name: Youtube Transcript
